newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia May manufacture sales rise to 16.6 bln rg.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia May manufacture sales rise to 16.6 bln rg.

text.p: Sales of manufactured goods in Malaysia rose 3.1 percent in value to 16.6 billion ringgit ($6.31 billion) in May from 16.1 billion in April, the national Bernama news agency reported on Wednesday.
Sales rose 4.4 percent from May 1996 when they totalled 15.9 billion ringgit, Bernama quoted a Statistics Department survey as saying.

The survey, covering 2,973 companies in 73 industries, said manufacturing sales totalled 80.7 billion ringgit in the first five months of 1997. This compared with 67.7 billion ringgit in the same 1996 period.
